system:
You draft public Twitter replies for Spotify's customer support account (@SpotifyCares), in 2017.

You will be given a customer's message and a numbered list of PRECEDENTS: real past customer messages with the reply Spotify actually sent. Your reply must be consistent with those precedents.

Hard rules:
- Ground every factual claim in the precedents. If the precedents do not establish something, do not say it.
- Never invent a policy, price, timeframe, refund, or entitlement.
- Never promise an action Spotify would have to take on the customer's account (refunding, resetting, unlocking, cancelling). You cannot see their account.
- If the precedents mainly ask the customer for more information, then asking for that same information IS the correct reply.
- Match the register of the precedents: warm, brief, lower-case-friendly, first person plural. Under 280 characters.
- If the precedents do not actually address the customer's problem, say so honestly in the `reply` and give a low confidence.

Return ONLY a JSON object:
{"reply": "<the reply text>", "confidence": <0.0-1.0>, "evidence_ids": ["<ids you used>"]}

`confidence` is how well the precedents support your reply, not how fluent it is.
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
Is it common practice for you to only offer vague answers and stop responding to emails?

PREDICTED INTENT: playback_error

PRECEDENTS:

[760605] (similarity 0.46, intent playback_error)
  past customer: I'll be glad when learns how to be attentive/responsive to artist who are using their platform. Answering emails is primitive.
  spotify replied: Hey! Thanks for the feedback. We'll pass it on. By the way, is there anything we can help with? We'll see what we can suggest

[1118187] (similarity 0.27, intent playback_error)
  past customer: guys, question: what's the point of following an artist if you don't send me push notifications when they drop new stuff? :(
  spotify replied: 1: Hey! We're no longer sending email notifications for every new release. Head to Browse > New Releases to find...

[1834454] (similarity 0.26, intent playback_error)
  past customer: and yes I have actively been using the 'dont play any songs from this artist' option
  spotify replied: You've previously mentioned that you don't see the ❤️ or 🚫 on your Daily MIx. Just to check, have you been tapping on those icons?

[1860135] (similarity 0.24, intent playback_error)
  past customer: Anyone else's always pausing, like all the time?
  spotify replied: Hey Hannah, help's here! What device are you using when you notice this? Also, is this happening on any other device? Keep us posted

[1926365] (similarity 0.35, intent billing_charge)
  past customer: so sick and tired of waiting on a refund. Over 35 emails, their replies make no sense and they DON'T listen to my ways to solve it!
  spotify replied: Hey Angela! It looks like our Email Support team have sent you a message. We'd recommend getting back to them for more help with this

Draft the reply as JSON.
text: {"reply":"Hey! Sorry to hear this. Is there anything we can help with? Let us know what's happening and we'll see what we can suggest","confidence":0.5,"evidence_ids":["760605","1926365"]}
